Now a stress driver script that runs many random cases and compares against the reference.

Note: my generator writes files with `open(path,'w',newline='')` and text may contain '\r' — good, newline='' prevents translation.

Let me run a stress test with small FIBs (so the Python reference is fast: the reference answer() is O(P) per candidate → O(P^2)). For P ≤ 300 that's 90k operations per file, fine in Python.

Let me write the driver.

arguments.command:
cat > /work/tmp/stress.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -u
BIN=/work/submit/planb64
T=/work/tmp
fails=0
for seed in $(seq "$1" "$2"); do
  nfib=${3:-40}; ntr=${4:-60}
  python3 $T/gen.py $seed $nfib $ntr $T/fib.txt $T/trace.txt >/dev/null || { echo "GEN FAIL $seed"; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; }
  python3 $T/ref.py build $T/fib.txt > $T/ref.idx 2>$T/ref.err || { echo "REF BUILD FAIL $seed"; cat $T/ref.err; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; }
  $BIN build $T/fib.txt $T/got.idx >$T/got.stdout 2>$T/got.stderr; rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "BUILD RC=$rc seed=$seed"; head -c 300 $T/got.stderr; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; fi
  if [ -s $T/got.stderr ]; then echo "BUILD STDERR seed=$seed"; head -c 300 $T/got.stderr; fails=$((fails+1)); fi
  if [ -s $T/got.stdout ]; then echo "BUILD STDOUT NONEMPTY seed=$seed"; fails=$((fails+1)); fi
  if ! cmp -s $T/got.idx $T/ref.idx; then echo "IDX MISMATCH seed=$seed"; diff <(head -50 $T/got.idx) <(head -50 $T/ref.idx) | head -20; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; fi
  python3 $T/ref.py lookup $T/ref.idx $T/trace.txt > $T/ref.out 2>$T/ref.err || { echo "REF LOOKUP FAIL $seed"; cat $T/ref.err; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; }
  for mode in scalar "batch 1" "batch 3" "batch 7" "batch 64" "batch 256" "batch 00017"; do
    $BIN lookup $T/got.idx $T/trace.txt $mode >$T/got.out 2>$T/got.stderr; rc=$?
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "LOOKUP RC=$rc seed=$seed mode=$mode"; head -c 200 $T/got.stderr; fails=$((fails+1)); continue; fi
    if [ -s $T/got.stderr ]; then echo "LOOKUP STDERR seed=$seed mode=$mode"; fails=$((fails+1)); fi
    if ! cmp -s $T/got.out $T/ref.out; then echo "OUT MISMATCH seed=$seed mode=$mode"; diff $T/got.out $T/ref.out | head -10; fails=$((fails+1)); fi
  done
done
echo "FAILS=$fails"
EOF
chmod +x /work/tmp/stress.sh
/work/tmp/stress.sh 1 25 30 40
